notes.title: SAINTS ROW – RELEASING ON STEAM ON AUGUST 24 2023
notes.content:
Today we can officially confirm that Saints Row will launch on Steam on August 24 2023. Mark your calendars and wishlist now to take advantage of our offers at release.

Over the past year we have been working on the game, improving features and implementing community feedback – Santo Ileso has never been so good, and there has never been a better time to dive in and start building your own criminal empire as The Saints. 
 
Here is a quick overview of what we have implemented:
 

 4 major updates + 1000s of changes, enhancements and new features
 Fan requested features added – including the Cheats App, Selfie Mode, emote wheel and loads more 
 Thousands of issues fixed and re-worked and major quality of life improvements made including overhauled combat, increased NPC density, and changes to VO 
 2 free district expansions with activities, stores and things to discover included for all players 
 Loads of additional clothing items in free-to-download packs
 2 story expansions (included in the Expansion Pass), with one more set to launch on August 8.
 Plus, on August 24 we will update the game with a new activity for all players on all platforms to enjoy. 

 
If you want to take the plunge into what went into each update, head to www.saintsrow.com/news to read all about it. 
 
Its almost time, to get this shit started - on Steam!
